title: Classify Robot Speed
instructions:
Write a function called `classifySpeed` that takes a `speed` parameter of type `Double` and returns a `String` describing the speed:

- speed == 0.0 -> return "Stopped"
- speed <= 0.3 -> return "Slow"
- speed <= 0.7 -> return "Medium"
- speed > 0.7 -> return "Fast"

Use if/else if/else or a when expression -- your choice!
hint: Check the conditions in order. You can use when with conditions: when { speed == 0.0 -> "Stopped" ... }
